subject.title: Gateway memory leak: 389MB → 14.7GB over 4 days with session accumulation

question: What representative RSS/heap profiling proof is sufficient to close this broad Gateway memory tracker after the current narrow mitigations?
rationale: Current main has several mitigations, but maintainer discussion and newer field data still require human judgment about the soak workload, profiling artifacts, and whether enough root-cause contributors have been addressed.

options.title: Keep broad tracker open
options.body: Continue using this issue as the canonical multi-day Gateway RSS/OOM tracker until a representative soak shows plateauing and remaining focused fixes are merged or explicitly split.

options.title: Split into focused issues
options.body: Move known contributors such as diagnostic hot paths, session-store bloat, and cache retention into narrower canonical issues while keeping cross-links to preserve field data.

options.title: Close after one mitigation
options.body: Close after a selected narrow PR lands, accepting the risk that newer multi-agent field reports remain unproven against current main.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker open
recommendation.body: Continue using this issue as the canonical multi-day Gateway RSS/OOM tracker until a representative soak shows plateauing and remaining focused fixes are merged or explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to osolmaz and their comment defines the current profiling/soak closure bar.
